title: Encourage a Stranger
body: Offer a genuine compliment or word of encouragement to someone you don't know well today.

title: Carry Someone's Burden
body: Ask a friend or family member how they are really doing, and actually listen to the answer.

title: Quiet Generosity
body: Do something generous for someone today without telling anyone you did it.

title: Forgive Something Small
body: Let go of a small offense today instead of holding onto it.

title: Pray for the Nations
body: Pray today for a missionary or a country you've never visited, that the Gospel would take root there.

title: Invite Someone to Church
body: Invite one person to join you at church or a small group this week.

title: Share Your Story
body: Tell one person today about a specific way God has been faithful to you.

title: Serve Behind the Scenes
body: Volunteer for a task at church this week that no one will notice you did.
